exercises.prompt: Complete the phrase with the agreeing adjective: 'in a large mosque'.
exercises.explanation: مَسْجِدٍ is masculine, singular, indefinite, and genitive; its attributive adjective must match all four: كَبِيرٍ.

feedback.rule: Attributive adjectives agree in gender, number, case, and definiteness.

exercises.prompt: Which structure expresses the superlative 'the greatest book'?
exercises.explanation: Placing the elative أَعْظَمُ as muḍāf before an indefinite genitive singular (كِتَابٍ) expresses the superlative.

feedback.rule: Elative أَفْعَلُ + genitive noun = superlative; أَفْعَلُ + مِنْ = comparative.

exercises.prompt: True or False: Elative adjectives on the pattern أَفْعَلُ take tanwīn when indefinite.
exercises.explanation: False. Pattern أَفْعَلُ is a diptote and never takes tanwīn.

feedback.rule: Pattern أَفْعَلُ is barred from tanwīn (diptote).
